title: Slice-aware quantization gating and calibration workflow for reranker (FP8/INT8)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a slice-aware calibration and gating pipeline to produce and validate FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles for the reranker model. The goal is to enable safe rollouts of quantized reranker variants with automated NDCG/MRR regression gates, per-slice alerts, and a documented rollback path. This ticket covers calibration config generation, a CI evaluation harness, dashboarding, and canary rollout playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Quantization profiles (INT8 and FP8) produced by the calibration pipeline and stored in model-catalog namespace with semantic versioning
End-to-end evaluation harness computes NDCG@10 and MRR across predefined slices and signals a pass if no slice shows >1.0 percentage-point absolute NDCG@10 regression compared to float baseline
CI gate blocks merging quant-profile changes that fail the NDCG/MRR thresholds; PR must include 'quant-profile' tag to trigger tests
Canary rollout plan documented in Console runbook with automatic fallback to float model on live regression (>1.5pp NDCG drop on production traffic)
steps: Define slice taxonomy: query-length buckets, head/tail queries, verticals, user cohort (beta vs general)
Run calibration sweeps: per-layer symmetric/asymmetric, per-channel vs per-tensor, clip thresholds, and collect activation histograms
Generate candidate quant-profiles and run offline rank-quality eval on holdout corpus (NDCG@1/3/10, MRR, pairwise win-rate)
Identify top candidates that meet slice gates and measure throughput/latency on dedicated nodes
Integrate gating test into PR CI and add a dashboard for slice-level time series and regression alerts
Create canary rollout configuration and rollback automation in Console
updates: 2026-02-25 - Ticket created by Aisha. Initial plan and acceptance criteria recorded.
2026-03-01 - First calibration sweep completed (100k calibration samples). Observed INT8 per-channel symmetric is promising; FP8 shows better median latency but unstable on very short queries.
2026-03-04 - Opened experimental branch and PR: github.com/redwood-inference/reranker/compare/quant-sweeps (PR #1987). Added unit tests for profile serialization.

2026-03-07 - Evaluated candidate profiles on holdout set (n=200k queries). Baseline float NDCG@10=0.742. INT8 candidate delta -0.004 (0.742 -> 0.738). FP8 candidate delta -0.001. Tail slice (length < 8 tokens) FP8 regression observed +1.6pp drop in NDCG@10.

2026-03-09 - Decision: require slice-aware gating. Added slice gate threshold: reject profile if any slice shows >1.0pp absolute NDCG@10 drop. INT8 passes all slices; FP8 fails short-query slice. Assignment: Luca to expand slice test coverage.

2026-03-12 - Integrated quant-eval job into CI (jenkins job: quant-eval-reranker-v2). Dashboard prototype: datadog.com/dashboards/reranker-quantization (internal). Next: add canary runbook and create runtime fallback hooks.
notes: Tradeoff: FP8 yields better throughput (~20% median latency reduction) but may introduce higher variance on short-context queries. We prefer conservative canary gating for FP8 until additional corrective measures (per-slice calibration or short-query-specific fallback) are implemented.
Calibration dataset must include anonymized production-style queries to surface real-world tail regressions; privacy filters applied and customer identifiers removed.
We will version quant profiles as semver-like tags: model_x.y.z+quant.int8.v1 and model_x.y.z+quant.fp8.v1 for traceability.
rollback_strategy: Canary flows default to float model if live NDCG@10 drops >1.5pp on production sampling window (5m). Automated Console runbook triggers immediate traffic shift and paged alert to on-call ML infra.
evaluation_summary: Float baseline (eval corpus, n=200k): NDCG@10 = 0.742, MRR = 0.512
INT8 (per-channel symmetric, 100k calib samples): NDCG@10 = 0.738 (-0.4pp abs), MRR = 0.509 (-0.3pp)
FP8 (dynamic range, 20k calib samples): NDCG@10 = 0.741 (-0.1pp abs) but short-query slice NDCG@10 dropped 1.6pp
Throughput: INT8 median p50 latency improvement ~12%; FP8 median p50 latency improvement ~20% on dedicated V100-equivalent nodes
Recommendation: Promote INT8 profile to canary in dedicated environment. Hold FP8 until slice-specific calibration or short-query fallback is implemented.
